title: Early musicians he remembers
summary: Names violinists and others he heard, including Paul Dominguez, Piron, Chris Kelly, Freddie Washington and Simeon, and says many are now dead.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: Oh yeah, no of my folks never played but there's a lot of fellas like Paul Dominguez. Was he playing violin? Violin, he was playing in them days. And Piron, he was playing in those days. And I just can't call a lot of those guys names, you know what I mean? I forgot a lot of them. Oh sure. And Chris Kelly, Kid Rainey, Frankie Duesen, a lot of those guys, you know what I mean? And oh there's so many of them. And Freddie Washington, well I'm- Oh the piano player. He was the piano player, you know him.
He's very sick now in California. Yeah, yeah. And I saw him last year.
And Lewis, well a lot of the boys are dead that I know played. There's a gang of them that died. One guy died just last week here, what's his name? Simeon.
